# Leftovers at the screen's edges, fix/edges144. Run at 1920x1080 (GUI scale 3 = 640x360, where 1.21.11's F3 text ends
# well above a bottom bar; GUI scale 2 = 960x540). The branch, then the old code for comparison:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/edges144 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/edges144.txt -f size=1920x1080
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/edges144 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/edges144.txt -f size=1920x1080
# main has no "debug fps/net/pie" (there they close F3), so its run only compares parts 1 and 4 (and the F3-alone shots).
# For old pictures of every part, with the charts showing, use the branch's test hook commit instead of main (batch 109
# plus the hook's chart switches alone): -f mod_ref=6cdf5a13
# Worth a run with -f version=1.21.1 too (its pie is drawn in the window's pixels, its F3 text is the old long one) and
# -f version=26.3 (a wider pie, the light map). The test world is creative: a bottom bar sits 50 above the bottom (64
# with hearts, in the survival shot).
#
# 1. Keyboard pick after a resize (GUI scale 2, as in window141-resize's rs-lib shots).
#    e144-lib-1080: the grid, the 15th card ("Copper Rust") picked with the keys, outlined, in the third row.
#    e144-lib-640 (640x480 = 320x240, four columns): branch: the outlined card is in view (the grid scrolled down to it,
#      the fourth row); old: rows 1 and 2 show, the outlined card is below the bottom until the next key.
#    e144-lib-640-mouse: the same after a mouse wheel scroll back to the top and a resize to 1920x1080 and back: the
#      grid stays at the top (a mouse user's scroll is kept), on both.
#    e144-shelf-1080 / e144-shelf-640: the shelf (two rows, then one), the 13th cover picked with the keys: branch:
#      after the resize the picked cover (raised, its name under the shelf) is in view; old: off to the right.
#    e144-settings-1080 / e144-settings-640: Display tab, the keyboard's ring on a row near the bottom of the view; after
#      the resize (rows narrower, a shorter panel): branch: the ring's row is in view; old: it can be below the bottom
#      (if the old picture shows it anyway, this case was not real at that size).
# 2. Bottom bar and F3's charts (GUI scale 3, 640x360, paused on a line).
#    e144-f3-text: F3 alone: the bar shows under F3's text (both; as bar133-f3-bottom-gui2).
#    e144-f3-fps (F3+2), e144-f3-fps-survival, e144-f3-net (F3+3), e144-f3-pie (F3+1): branch: no bar; old (6cdf5a13):
#      the bar under the charts' grey strip along the bottom (the frame time chart from the left, the tick or
#      ping chart from the right, both 242 wide) or under the pie's dark box in the bottom right corner.
#    e144-f3-fps-gui2 (960x540): the charts stay beside the bar and the bar shows (both).
#    On 1.21.1 the right column (the tags of the sand in view) already reaches the bar, so it hides with F3 alone, and
#    its pie (drawn in the window's pixels, 110 wide at GUI scale 3) stays right of the bar.
# 3. Record card in a bottom corner and F3 (GUI scale 3, the bar at the top).
#    e144-card-f3-text: bottom left card, F3 alone: branch: the card shows (F3's text ends far above it); old: no card
#      (it hid on any screen up to about 370 tall).
#    e144-card-f3-fps: the same with F3+2: no card on the branch (the frame time chart covers its corner); old
#      (6cdf5a13): the chart drawn over the card.
#    e144-card-f3-pie: bottom right card with F3+1: branch: no card; old: the pie's box over it (1.21.1: its pie sits
#      higher up and smaller and misses the card, which shows on both).
# 4. The note in the top bar for the demo song's missing cover, Minecraft's letters (zoom on the round space at the
#    bar's left end): e144-note-gui3, -gui2, -gui4. Old: its pixels are 2 or 3 screen pixels by turns at GUI 3 (1 or 2 at
#    GUI 2, 3 or 4 at GUI 4). Branch: every pixel the same: 3 at GUI 3, 2 at GUI 2, 3 at GUI 4 (a little bigger than
#    before at GUI 2 and 3, a little smaller at GUI 4).

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout LINES
guiscale 2
resize 1920x1080
look 0 -20
sleep 8

# 1. Keyboard pick after a resize: the grid, the shelf, the settings
set libraryView GRID
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 0.5
key down
sleep 0.5
key right
sleep 0.5
key right
sleep 1.5
shot e144-lib-1080
resize 640x480
sleep 2
shot e144-lib-640
scroll 10
sleep 1
resize 1920x1080
sleep 1
resize 640x480
sleep 2
shot e144-lib-640-mouse
close
resize 1920x1080
sleep 2
set libraryView SHELF
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
key down
sleep 0.3
key right
sleep 0.3
key right
sleep 0.3
key right
sleep 0.3
key right
sleep 0.3
key right
sleep 0.3
key right
sleep 1.5
shot e144-shelf-1080
resize 640x480
sleep 2
shot e144-shelf-640
close
set libraryView GRID
resize 1920x1080
sleep 2
gui 3
sleep 3
key down
sleep 0.3
key down
sleep 0.3
key down
sleep 0.3
key down
sleep 0.3
key down
sleep 0.3
key down
sleep 0.3
key down
sleep 0.3
key down
sleep 1.5
shot e144-settings-1080
resize 640x480
sleep 2
shot e144-settings-640
close
resize 1920x1080
sleep 2

# 2. Bottom bar and F3's charts, paused on a line
guiscale 3
set barPosition BOTTOM
music pause
sleep 1
seek 25.5
sleep 2
debug on
sleep 2
shot e144-f3-text
debug fps
sleep 2
shot e144-f3-fps
cmd gamemode survival @p
sleep 2
shot e144-f3-fps-survival
cmd gamemode creative @p
debug fps
debug net
sleep 2
shot e144-f3-net
debug net
debug pie
sleep 3
shot e144-f3-pie
debug pie
debug fps
guiscale 2
sleep 2
shot e144-f3-fps-gui2
guiscale 3
debug fps
debug off
set barPosition TOP
sleep 1

# 3. Record card in a bottom corner and F3
set recordCard true
set cardCorner BOTTOM_LEFT
sleep 2
debug on
sleep 2
shot e144-card-f3-text
debug fps
sleep 2
shot e144-card-f3-fps
debug fps
set cardCorner BOTTOM_RIGHT
debug pie
sleep 3
shot e144-card-f3-pie
debug pie
debug off
set recordCard false
set cardCorner BOTTOM_LEFT
sleep 1

# 4. The no-cover note, Minecraft's letters, at GUI scale 3, 2 and 4
set smoothFont false
sleep 2
shot e144-note-gui3
guiscale 2
sleep 2
shot e144-note-gui2
guiscale 4
sleep 2
shot e144-note-gui4
guiscale 3
music play
